# LuizEngine Fluent UI Toolbar Icons

This directory contains toolbar icon PNG assets copied from LuizEngine's generated editor content:

- `toolbar_play.png`
- `toolbar_pause.png`

The assets originate from LuizEngine's Fluent UI Emoji third-party package and are distributed under the MIT license included in `LICENSE`.

Source paths used during import:

- `H:\LuizEngine\Build\Bin\Debug\Content\EditorShell\LeUIIconAssets\FluentEmoji\toolbar_play.png`
- `H:\LuizEngine\Build\Bin\Debug\Content\EditorShell\LeUIIconAssets\FluentEmoji\toolbar_pause.png`
- `H:\LuizEngine\Engine\ThirdParty\fluentui-emoji\LICENSE`
